declarations.description: A persistent, full-width message placed in the page flow: system notices, outages, trial expiry, cookie consent.
declarations.name: Banner

cssProperties.description: Share of the variant colour mixed into the background.
cssProperties.name: --c2-banner__container__variant--background-mix

cssProperties.description: Share of the variant colour in the border colour.
cssProperties.name: --c2-banner__container__variant--border-mix

cssParts.description: Container wrapping the `icon` slot: the variant SVG by default, or the assigned icon.
cssParts.name: icon

cssParts.description: Container for the heading and message.
cssParts.name: content

cssParts.description: Container for the assigned actions slot.
cssParts.name: actions

slots.description: Leading icon, with a variant-specific SVG default.
slots.name: icon

slots.description: Buttons or links shown after the message.
slots.name: actions

members.name: message
members.description: Plain-text message; the default slot can replace it.

members.name: variant
members.description: Semantic variant: tints the banner with the matching icon colour. `warning` and `error` are announced as alerts, the others as status messages.

members.name: noIcon
members.description: Hides the leading icon and removes its space from the layout.

members.name: closeLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the dismiss button.

members.name: dismiss
members.description: Requests dismissal. Fires `banner-close`; unless it is prevented the banner is hidden. Returns whether it was hidden.

members.name: show
members.description: Shows a banner hidden by dismiss().

events.description: The dismiss button was activated. Cancelable; unless prevented the banner hides itself.
events.name: banner-close
